label: Farewell Party at the Hot Spring

lines.text: A special event has occurred.
Participate in the event.
Go back.
Our final day at Snowfield Hot Spring has arrived,
and so we gather in the dining area for the farewell party.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It only feels like we've just arrived,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and it's already the last day.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I know...

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: What a bummer.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Finally, I can part ways with these dunderheads.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: How are you feeling, Signal?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I'm really sad as well.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: But goodbye doesn't have to mean forever.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Pretty good line, huh!

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: It's from a TV show I've been watching.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Very suave.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: And I agree with what it's saying.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Y-you do?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Hehe, I'm glad.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I don't feel that sad, to be honest.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I ate all sorts of good food and had a great time with Mica.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Everyone has experienced a lot of emotional events here at Snowfield Hot Spring.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: As the owner of Snowfield, I'd like to say a few words before we start.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Although the time we spent here may have been short, it will be a memory that's unforgettable. Thank you all for spending time with us at Snowfield.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: All of us will soon be going our separate ways.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I hope that the experiences you've had here will act as a positive and motivating force in your lives whenever you're up against a challenge.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Now then,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: let's get this party underway!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Woohoo! This is gonna be fun!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Blanc, do you think it'd be okay for us to have some champagne? Just one glass each.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: No, you can't, Noir. You know you can't handle your alcohol.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I prepared a special 3-tiered layer cake for everyone. I hope you all enjoy it!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Wow, it's massive!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: How are we ever gonna finish it all?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hehe, we'll all have to have a little extra.
Everyone enjoys the party in their own way, as we all eat and drink.
Everyone is having an awesome time.
A moment later.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I think now is the perfect time to unveil what we've prepared.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: What do you think, ladies?

lines.speaker: blanc_noir
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Okay.
What's this now?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: All of us prepared a thank-you gift

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: for all your hard work.
Blanc, Noir, Emma, Mica, and Ludmilla.
Each of them produced gift-wrapped presents that had been hidden out of sight.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We prepared something special for you.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We hope you like it!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hehe, it's a gift for you, Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's a bit embarrassing doing this out in the open like this...
But I didn't prepare anything for any of you...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: That's okay.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We didn't expect anything in return. We did this because we wanted to.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Well then,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: whose gift would you like to open first, Servant?
Open Blanc and Noir's gift.
Open Emma's gift.
Open Ludmilla's gift.
Open Mica's gift.
Have everyone open the gifts all at once.
Let's start with Blanc and Noir's gift.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I hope you like it.
*Sssssssh*
I untie the ribbon
and carefully open the box.
It's a...
Inside the box, there is a hot spring towel emblazoned with two rabbits.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We made a towel with our favorite symbol on it!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's to commemorate our time at Snowfield.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Snowfield, and the hot spring, have become very meaningful to us,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: so you should use this every time you take a bath back at the Ark!
Thank you.
After that, I received the rest of my gifts, including: Emma's homemade cookies made to resemble me,
a heart-shaped stone Mica had picked out for me,
and special tea bags Ludmilla had prepared just for me.
Let's start with Emma's gift.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I worked really hard on it.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm sure you'll love it!
*Sssssssh*
I untie the ribbon
and carefully open the box.
Hmm?
Inside the box, there is a motley assortment of bizarrely-shaped cookies.
What... are these, exactly?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh... I thought you'd be able to tell straight away.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: They're homemade cookies made to look like you.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I think they turned out wonderfully. You see the eyes here? They look just like yours.
... Is this how you think I look?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sure! They're the spitting image of you.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Of everything I've made here at Snowfield, I put the most effort into making these.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: So, you're not allowed to give them away to anyone! You've got to eat them all yourself.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I also made some other cookies to give to everyone separately.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Um...
Th-thanks. I'm sure they'll taste wonderful.
After that, I received the rest of my gifts, including: a towel from Blanc and Noir with rabbit patterns on it,
a heart-shaped stone Mica had picked out for me,
and special tea bags Ludmilla had prepared just for me.
Let's start with Ludmilla's gift.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: All right,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: go ahead and open it.
*Sssssssh*
I untie the ribbon
and carefully open the box.
It's a...
Inside the box, there's another smaller box of neatly packaged tea bags.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I created this blend myself, and used the feelings I've experienced here at Snowfield as inspiration.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: There might be a slight bitterness in the beginning, but that will give way to a faint floral aftertaste which will spread across the palette.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: At first, the Snowfield might have felt cold and unwelcoming,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: but after spending some time together here, it's a warm and inviting place.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I've tried to express that feeling, that transformation, with this tea blend.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I hope you like it.
Thank you. I'll have a cup whenever I think of Snowfield.
After that, I received the rest of my gifts, including: a towel from Blanc and Noir with rabbit patterns on it,
a heart-shaped stone Mica had picked out for me,
and Emma's homemade cookies made to resemble me.
Let's start with Mica's gift.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hehe, okay. I'm not sure if you'll like it,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: but I really combed through every inch of Snowfield.
*Sssssssh*
I untie the ribbon
and carefully open the box.
It's a...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: While I've been out collecting stones to skip,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I've found all sorts of funky stones in all different shapes and textures.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That got me thinking about if I could find one in a certain shape.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I really had to do some digging, but eventually I found this little guy shaped like a heart,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: and I wanted to give it to you.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I know it might not be as nice as the other gifts everyone has prepared, but...
No, I really appreciate it. It came from the heart.
I'll put it on the shelf in my room.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Wow, I'm honored!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Thank you, Old-Timer!

Emma's homemade cookies made to resemble me,
and special tea bags Ludmilla had prepared just for me.
Since it's hard to choose just one, let's all open them at once.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Are you sure? That might take some of the thrill out of it.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Who are we to protest? The person who's receiving the gifts wants it that way.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Anyway, I prepared some tea bags.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I used the feelings and experiences we've had here at Snowfield as inspiration. You can try them when you get back.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I baked homemade cookies shaped like you, Commander.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: They look just like you! Aren't they adorable?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I found you a heart-shaped stone.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Stones come in so many different shapes and textures,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: and I found this one which I thought was super unique.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It might not be as nice as the other gifts, but I hope you'll like it.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Noir and I made you a bath towel with rabbits sewn on it.

lines.speaker: noir_c

lines.speaker: noir_c

As my arms are gradually filled with everyone's gifts,
our final night at Snowfield Hot Spring slowly comes to a close.
After the party,
everyone goes back to their rooms for the night.
I look around all of Snowfield Hot Spring with a profound sense of melancholy:
The bamboo forest stands tall, deep in the snow.
The warm tendrils of steam wafting up from the hot spring.
The walking trail which casts out all worries and sorrow from your mind.
The restaurant that always smells of delicious food.
The waterfall, an emblem of dynamic strength and serene beauty all at once.
The dormitory, where we started and ended each day.
And finally...
only one thing remained.
Lumi.
It's almost time.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
The day may be over,
but the story of Snowfield Hot Spring
is only just beginning.
Snowfield Hot Spring Farewell party: END
